words.example: More people now live in [urban] areas than in the countryside.
words.exampleZh: 現在住在都市的人比住在鄉下的人多。

words.example: Local [residents] complained about the noise.
words.exampleZh: 當地居民抱怨噪音。

words.example: Dark clothes [absorb] more heat from the sun.
words.exampleZh: 深色衣服會吸收更多陽光的熱。

words.example: Thick walls [insulate] the house from the cold.
words.exampleZh: 厚牆讓房子能隔絕寒冷。

words.example: Regular exercise has many health [benefits].
words.exampleZh: 規律運動對健康有很多好處。

words.example: Green space is [rare] in the city center.
words.exampleZh: 市中心的綠地很少見。

words.example: The bridge is the tallest [structure] in town.
words.exampleZh: 這座橋是鎮上最高的建築。

words.example: It costs a lot to [maintain] an old building.
words.exampleZh: 維護一棟老建築要花很多錢。

words.example: The farmers expect a good [harvest] this year.
words.exampleZh: 農夫們預期今年會豐收。

words.example: Bees [pollinate] many of the crops we eat.
words.exampleZh: 蜜蜂為我們吃的許多作物授粉。

words.example: The birds found [shelter] under the roof.
words.exampleZh: 鳥兒在屋簷下找到了遮蔽處。

words.example: The whole [community] helped clean the park.
words.exampleZh: 整個社區一起幫忙打掃公園。

words.example: City [planners] want to add more bike lanes.
words.exampleZh: 城市規劃者想增設更多自行車道。

words.example: The [temperature] dropped sharply at night.
words.exampleZh: 夜裡氣溫驟降。

words.example: Learning a language takes time and [effort].
words.exampleZh: 學一種語言需要時間與努力。

words.example: The school [makes use of] its empty roof as a garden.
words.exampleZh: 學校把空著的屋頂拿來當花園。

words.example: Students take turns to [take care of] the plants.
words.exampleZh: 學生輪流照顧植物。

words.example: The long hike was hard, but the view [was worth the effort].
words.exampleZh: 健行很辛苦，但那片風景值得。

words.example: The rooftop garden [is home to] dozens of bees.
words.exampleZh: 這座屋頂花園有數十隻蜜蜂棲息。

words.example: The old parking lot was [turned into] a playground.
words.exampleZh: 舊停車場被改建成遊樂場。
